verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a first-party, OpenAI-compatible API for its core inference work, including chat with tier controls (service_tier, fail_fast, reasoning_effort) and a wide model catalog. Nothing in the evidence states that the API matches what the UI can do, and probes found no published OpenAI spec. Missing for 10: any documented claim of API/UI parity, API endpoints for account, API-key, billing and usage management, API-driven deployment of private or fine-tuned models and GPU clusters, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and your code works without changes. No migration required.
Set service_tier to "priority" to request priority inference on supported models.
Set service_tier to "flex" to run Chat Completions requests at a lower cost in exchange for slower response times and occasional resource unavailability.
